Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Recover the obscured 4x4 patch using the grid's 180-degree symmetry."""
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 3]
    if not cells:
        return grid
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, _ in cells)
    c0 = min(c for _, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in cells)
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    return [[grid[height - 1 - r][width - 1 - c]
             for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)]
            for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
"
